verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs mention a "standalone simulang CLI" alongside simulang-js and a /simulang skill for Claude Code, so an official CLI exists. Beyond that one line, the evidence gives no commands, install steps, or AI-native workflow features, and the primary Sai interfaces are listed as the HTTPS API, Python SDK and MCP server rather than a CLI. missing for 10: CLI command reference and install docs, evidence the CLI drives Sai agent tasks (not just simulang scripts), independent or hands-on corroboration.
